scripts.db:migrate: cd packages/db && bun --env-file=../../.env x drizzle-kit migrate
scripts.db:generate: cd packages/db && bun --env-file=../../.env x drizzle-kit generate
scripts.db:push-schema: cd packages/db && bun --env-file=../../.env x drizzle-kit push
scripts.db:ingest: cd packages/db && bun --env-file=../../.env run src/etl/index.ts ingest
scripts.db:rebuild-index: cd packages/db && bun --env-file=../../.env run src/etl/index.ts rebuild-index
scripts.db:studio: cd packages/db && bun --env-file=../../.env x drizzle-kit studio
